verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Beamer collects and prioritizes feedback and offers a public roadmap, and its widget installs via embed code. Nothing documents a linkable feedback-portal URL or a way for developers to add a link in their product that sends users to it. The embed code applies to the changelog widget, and the general feedback claims are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a link in my product that directs users to the feedback portal
